method.notes: Identical sources, production builds, one server at a time, cyclic engine order, new server each run. Before uses preserved current-comparison build AND the saved native binary. Next uses its preserved Next 16.3.5 webpack build. CPU and RSS sum server descendants including RSC threads, load client excluded but shares host. RSS shared pages may be counted twice. Three short trials per scenario; sustained and overload one trial. Old Rustyx C512 overload can reject requests; CPU per success then includes rejected work. Latency includes successful responses only. No profiler/build/test jobs during load.
